description: Agent-based diffusion of a pro-social behavior over a multilayer social network with policy and media interventions. Individuals adopt based on weighted social influence, personal traits, and external signals; daily contacts are sampled from household, workplace/school, and community layers.

modules.name: DemographicsAndNetworkBuilder
modules.description: Initializes agent attributes and constructs a multilayer social network (household, workplace/school, community) with homophily and small-world community structure.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if step == 0:
  set RNG(seed=random_seed)
  N = network.population_size
  assign age_group for each person i using demo.p_age_18_34, p_age_35_64, p_age_65p
  assign ses for each person i using demo.p_ses_low, p_ses_mid, p_ses_high
  draw openness_i ~ Beta(openness_alpha, openness_beta)
  draw conformity_i ~ Beta(conformity_alpha, conformity_beta)
  draw threshold_i ~ TruncatedNormal(mean=behavior.threshold_mean, sd=behavior.threshold_sd, bounds [0,1])
  mark stubborn_i as Bernoulli(behavior.stubborn_fraction)
  set adoption_state_i ~ Bernoulli(global.initial_adoption_rate)
  Build households by sampling sizes from Lognormal(mu=network.household_size_mu, sigma=network.household_size_sigma), cap to N, connect clique edges per household
  Build workplaces/schools: assign fraction network.school_fraction to schools; sample group sizes Poisson(mean=network.workplace_size_mu); connect clique edges per group
  Build community layer using Watts-Strogatz with N nodes, k=network.community_ws_k, beta=network.community_ws_beta; apply homophily rewiring with strength network.homophily_age and network.homophily_ses; cap degrees at network.degree_cap
  store degrees per layer for each i
  output graphs and person attributes
notes: Homophily rewiring: preferentially rewire edges to nodes sharing age_group or SES with probability proportional to homophily strengths.

modules.name: DailyContactSampler
modules.description: Samples the set of active contacts per day from each network layer and adds small random contact noise.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each layer L in [household, workplace, community]:
  pL = contacts.daily_active_fraction * layer_bias[L]
  sample each edge e in graph.layers.L as active with probability clamp(pL, 0, 1)
Add noise contacts: for m in 1..round(N * contacts.noise_contact_rate):
  pick two random distinct persons (i, j); add (i, j) to active set for today
Set contacts.active_edges = union of active edges across layers plus noise
notes: layer_bias = {household: contacts.household_bias, workplace: contacts.workplace_bias, community: contacts.community_bias}
Use Bernoulli sampling per edge for performance or reservoir sampling if very dense.

modules.name: PolicyCampaign
modules.description: Generates time-varying policy and media signals affecting adoption probability.

update_rule.pseudocode:
t = time.day_index
if t < policy.start_day or t > policy.end_day:
  policy_signal = 0.0
  media_signal = 0.0
else:
  # Policy ramps up and down with a smooth window
  progress = (t - policy.start_day) / max(1, (policy.end_day - policy.start_day))
  ramp = 1 / (1 + exp(-10*(progress-0.5)))
  policy_signal = policy.enforcement_strength * ramp + min(1.0, policy.incentive_amount / 100.0) * 0.3
  media_signal = policy.media_boost * ramp
# Target group filtering (if not 'all', restrict effects to matching agents)
output policy.signal_t = policy_signal
output media.signal_t = media_signal
notes: In SocialInfluenceUpdater, if policy.target_group != 'all', apply signals only to agents in the target group filter.

modules.name: SocialInfluenceUpdater
modules.description: Updates each person's adoption state using a weighted-threshold logistic model with memory, social influence by layer, media, policy, and personal traits.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  # compute today's social signal as weighted fraction adopted among active neighbors
  neighbors = active_neighbors_of(i) from contacts.active_edges
  if neighbors is empty: social_today = 0 else social_today = mean(adoption_state_j for j in neighbors)
  # blend with memory (EWMA)
  mem = persons.memory_signal[i]
  social_blended = (1 - behavior.memory_decay) * mem + behavior.memory_decay * social_today
  persons.memory_signal[i] = social_blended
  # layer-specific weighting approximated via biases already in contact sampling; add explicit weights
  social_weighted = social_blended * behavior.social_weight
  external = behavior.media_weight * media.signal_t + behavior.policy_weight * policy.signal_t_for_i
  # personal bias terms
  bias = behavior.bias_openness_weight * persons.openness[i] + behavior.bias_conformity_weight * persons.conformity[i]
  # threshold (increase if stubborn)
  th = persons.threshold[i] * (1.0 + 0.5 * persons.stubborn[i])
  # adoption probability via logistic
  z = behavior.baseline_intent + social_weighted + external + bias - th
  p_adopt = 1 / (1 + exp(- z / max(1e-6, behavior.logit_temperature)))
  if persons.adoption_state[i] == 0:
    if Bernoulli(p_adopt) == 1:
      persons.adoption_state[i] = 1
      persons.adoption_time[i] = time.day_index
      record events.new_adoptions += 1
  else:
    # potential reversion if support low
    p_revert = behavior.reversion_rate * max(0.0, 1.0 - social_blended)
    if Bernoulli(p_revert) == 1:
      persons.adoption_state[i] = 0
      record events.reversions += 1
notes: policy.signal_t_for_i equals policy.signal_t if policy.target_group == 'all'; otherwise 0 unless i matches the target group filter.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates observable outputs such as overall adoption rate, new adoptions, and group-level adoption rates with optional smoothing.

update_rule.pseudocode:
N = count(persons)
rate_total_raw = mean(adoption_state)
rate_total = aggregator.smoothing_alpha * rate_total_raw + (1 - aggregator.smoothing_alpha) * prev(rate_total)
new_adopt_raw = events.new_adoptions
new_adopt = round(aggregator.smoothing_alpha * new_adopt_raw + (1 - aggregator.smoothing_alpha) * prev(new_adopt))
subset_age = {i: persons.age_group[i] == '18_34'}
rate_age = mean(adoption_state over subset_age)
subset_ses = {i: persons.ses[i] == 'low'}
rate_ses_low = mean(adoption_state over subset_ses)
output observable.adoption_rate_daily = rate_total
output observable.new_adoptions_daily = new_adopt
output observable.adoption_rate_by_age_18_34 = rate_age
output observable.adoption_rate_by_ses_low = rate_ses_low
notes: Simple exponential smoothing to mitigate day-to-day sampling noise.
prev(x) denotes previous day's value; initialize with first raw value.

algorithms.WeightedThresholdLogistic: Adoption decision uses a logistic function of social influence (EWMA), media, policy, personal traits, and threshold.
algorithms.WattsStrogatzCommunity: Generates small-world community layer with parameters k and beta, then applies homophily-biased rewiring.
algorithms.DailyEdgeActivation: Bernoulli activation of edges per layer with per-layer bias and additive random contacts.
algorithms.ExponentialSmoothing: Applies EWMA to observables to reduce noise.
algorithms.HomophilyRewiring: Rewires a fraction of edges to increase assortative mixing by age and SES.
